statement: Paper B Lemma 4.3, bound (4.3), with explicit constants. Let E_R(t) = min(1, 1/(R ||t||)), with E_R = 1 at integers, where ||t|| is the distance to the nearest integer. For R >= 1 and r0 <= r1, the sum of E_R(n^{3/2}) over the odd starts n = 2r+1 with r in [r0, r1) is at most 4 (r1 - r0)(floor(log_2 R) + 2)/R + 25344 r1^{5/6}. For an interval I in [P, 3P] this is the printed O(P log(2R)/R + P^{5/6}). The proof extends Theorem 3.1's discrepancy bound to every arc (264 a^{5/6} on a block, 1056 R^{5/6} on a prefix), covers the points with ||n^{3/2}|| < z by three arcs of n^{3/2}/2 of total length 2z, and sums the dyadic layers E_R(t) <= sum_{j <= J} 2^{1-j} [||t|| < 2^j/R]. The first assertion of Lemma 4.3, b = b_R + O(E_R), is not covered.
